fact: The party climbs onto the back of Themberchaud as he takes flight within the massive cavern.
source_quote: The party climbs onto the voluminous back of the dragon as he takes flight within the massive cavern.
subject: party boarding Themberchaud

fact: Gracklstugh sits in a huge cavern, but beyond it are only small tunnels, preventing Themberchaud from leaving easily.
source_quote: the city sits in a huge cavern, but beyond it are only small tunnels, so Themberchaud cannot really leave
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The party attempts to persuade Themberchaud to drop them off at the docks of the Darklake.
source_quote: The party attempts to persuade Themberchaud to drop them off at the docks of the Darklake.
subject: docks persuasion attempt

fact: Thorin notes that being dropped at the docks lets them skip the gates entirely.
source_quote: Thorin notes this lets them skip the gates entirely.
subject: Thorin's gate strategy

fact: Gyrgum proposes being dropped straight into a boat to hijack it.
source_quote: Gyrgum floats the idea of being dropped straight into a boat to hijack it.
subject: Gyrgum's boat proposal

fact: Themberchaud initially scoffs at the idea of loitering among common traders.
source_quote: At first he scoffed that his agents had better things to do than "loiter among the common rabble and petty traders."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 13 on Persuasion, and the help-granted reroll yields a worse result.
source_quote: Gyrgum's Persuasion roll was a middling 13, and the help-granted reroll came out worse.
subject: Gyrgum's persuasion roll

fact: Themberchaud reveals he has no clue where the party should investigate.
source_quote: When Gyrgum asked Themberchaud where he thought they should investigate, it became obvious the dragon had no idea.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Daz suggests dropping the party at the docks.
source_quote: Daz suggested dropping them there.
subject: Daz's suggestion

fact: Gyrgum promises to "find the devil in the details."
source_quote: Gyrgum promised to "find the devil in the details."
subject: Gyrgum's promise

fact: Zalthir cites the recent attack near the docks as a source of fresh intelligence.
source_quote: Zalthir pointed to the recent attack near the docks as a source of fresh intelligence.
subject: Zalthir's evidence

fact: Themberchaud concedes that the party has a good point about missing a crucial district.
source_quote: He was persuaded... He concedes, "Hmm, that's a good point."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud makes a chaotic, lurching maneuver to turn toward the docks due to excess weight and lack of exercise.
source_quote: as he banked into a turn, his excess weight and lack of recent exercise made for a chaotic, lurching maneuver.
subject: Themberchaud's bank turn

fact: Party members make DC 13 Athletics or Acrobatics checks to stay on Themberchaud.
source_quote: It called for DC 13 Athletics or Acrobatics checks
subject: Athletics/Acrobatics checks

fact: Gyrgum gets a 12 on his check.
source_quote: Gyrgum gets 12.
subject: Gyrgum's check

fact: Thorin rolls a natural 3 plus 4, uses a 1d10 boost, and still fails his check.
source_quote: Thorin rolls a natural 3 +4, then uses a 1d10 boost and still fails.
subject: Thorin's check

fact: Daz gets an 8 on his check.
source_quote: Daz gets 8.
subject: Daz's check

fact: Several party members lose their footing and begin to fall from Themberchaud's back.
source_quote: Several party members lose their footing and begin to fall.
subject: party slipping

fact: Zalthir sprouts wings and catches the falling Thorin.
source_quote: Zalthir sprouted wings and caught the falling Thorin
subject: Zalthir's rescue

fact: Daz casts Misty Step, vanishing in silvery mist and reappearing beside the flying Zalthir.
source_quote: Daz vanished in a burst of silvery mist and reappeared beside the flying Zalthir.
subject: Daz's Misty Step

fact: As Gyrgum falls, he cries out to Bahamut.
source_quote: As Gyrgum falls, he cries out to Bahamut.
subject: Gyrgum's prayer

fact: Jimjar hurls a rope to the tumbling Gyrgum.
source_quote: Jimjar, ever the quick thinker, hurled a rope to the tumbling Gyrgum
subject: Jimjar's rescue

fact: Gyrgum catches the rope with a 19 on Acrobatics and is hauled back up by the party.
source_quote: Gyrgum caught it with a 19 on Acrobatics and was hauled back up by the combined effort of his companions.
subject: Gyrgum's recovery

fact: Themberchaud appears distraught and flaps harder, noting that if dragons could sweat, there would be lots of sweat.
source_quote: Themberchaud, distraught, flaps harder. "If dragons could sweat, there would be lots of sweat."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud gives fly-bys of his town through foul, forge-choked air.
source_quote: Themberchaud proudly gives fly-bys of his town. The air is foul with forge smoke.
subject: Fly-bys

fact: The party ties themselves together with rope.
source_quote: The party ties themselves together with rope.
subject: rope

fact: Themberchaud performs a fly-by of the Forge of Thrazgad.
source_quote: Themberchaud performs a fly-by of the Forge of Thrazgad
subject: Forge of Thrazgad

fact: Themberchaud breathes a torrent of fire to light the forge below.
source_quote: breathing a torrent of fire to light the forge below
subject: lighting the forge

fact: Themberchaud delivers a booming speech about his own greatness.
source_quote: He hovered and delivered a booming speech about his own greatness
subject: Themberchaud's boasting

fact: The duergar below roll their eyes at Themberchaud's ego.
source_quote: The duergar below rolled their eyes at his ego.
subject: duergar

fact: The citizens of Gracklstugh look up in stunned terror at the dragon and the figures on his back.
source_quote: the citizens of Gracklstugh looked up in stunned terror, not just at the dragon but at the figures on his back.
subject: citizens of Gracklstugh

fact: Daz rolls a natural 20 on Insight.
source_quote: Daz rolled a natural 20 on Insight
subject: Daz's insight

fact: The crowd believes the riders are the Ember Vanguard, agents of the Drow Empire.
source_quote: worked out what the crowd believed: the Ember Vanguard, the legendary and feared agents of the Drow Empire, were riding the Wyrmsmith himself.
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: The entire city falls into a panic.
source_quote: The entire city fell into a panic.
subject: city panic

fact: In rumor, Daz is an 18th-level mage able to cast Meteor Swarm.
source_quote: In rumor, Daz is an 18th-level mage able to cast Meteor Swarm.
subject: Daz

fact: Themberchaud lands heavily at the docks.
source_quote: Themberchaud lands heavily at the docks.
subject: landing at docks

fact: Themberchaud roars and uses his frightful presence to frighten the local populace.
source_quote: He roars and uses his frightful presence to frighten the local populace.
subject: frightful presence

fact: Gyrgum agrees to search the docks far and wide.
source_quote: Gyrgum answers, "Aye aye, we will search the docks far and wide"
subject: Gyrgum's agreement

fact: Themberchaud departs for his lair.
source_quote: before the dragon departs for his lair.
subject: Themberchaud departs
